brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆数据，才是后训练智能体数据的新前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; the bottleneck is building evals for every domain.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异几乎完全来自数据而非算法；真正的瓶颈是为每个领域构建评测。

brendanfoody.en: Models cannot reliably grade their own work, so humans remain essential for verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型无法可靠地给自己的产出打分，因此人类在验证器与评分标准上仍不可或缺。

brendanfoody.en: Humans' last job is creating data to train AI; workers shift from repetitive tasks to training agents.
brendanfoody.zh: 人类最后的工作是为训练 AI 创造数据，劳动者从重复性任务转向训练智能体。

brendanfoody.en: Every Fortune 500 will become a neolab training its own models on proprietary data, not sharing with frontier labs.
brendanfoody.zh: 每家财富 500 强都将成为新实验室，用专有数据训练自己的模型，而不与前沿实验室共享数据。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: more tokens, not just bigger models; data quality and open-source scrutiny matter most.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：关键不只是把模型做大，更要训练更多 token；数据质量与开源审视最重要。

mensch.en: Compute alone is insufficient; algorithmic efficiency and data quality can yield 100x gains, with value accruing at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步强调单靠算力不够，算法效率与数据质量可带来百倍提升，价值最终落在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should augment rather than replace jobs; sovereign, decentralized open-source AI empowers enterprises and requires human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从技术效率转向部署与治理：AI 应增强而非取代工作，主权化、去中心化的开源 AI 赋能企业，并需人在回路。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms replatforming software.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调、企业定制，以及智能体式平台对软件的重塑。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe must own frontier AI and compute infrastructure within a two-year window.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年更晚时，他明确 AGI 是方向而非终点；欧洲必须在两年窗口内掌握前沿 AI 与算力基础设施，主权 AI 是结构性经济问题。

jaderberg.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; RL and agents explore vast chemical space.
jaderberg.zh: 药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

jaderberg.en: Biology isn't data-constrained; data is the real bottleneck, not models or compute.
jaderberg.zh: 生物学并非受数据限制；真正的瓶颈是数据，而非模型或算力。

jaderberg.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology, justifying a company to solve all diseases via general, disease-agnostic models.
jaderberg.zh: AlphaFold 证明深度学习在生物学中可泛化，这支撑了用通用、跨疾病模型解决所有疾病的公司使命。

jaderberg.en: Shift drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; model human toxicity, not just target binding.
jaderberg.zh: 把药物发现从经验驱动转向预测性的计算机驱动设计；建模人体毒性，而不只是靶点结合。

jaderberg.en: Get out of the real world via world models rather than speeding lab iteration; human attention and physical space remain bottlenecks even at AGI.
jaderberg.zh: 用世界模型走出真实世界，而非仅加速实验室迭代；即便达到 AGI（通用人工智能），人类注意力与物理空间仍是瓶颈。

laurentan.en: Trust is the real bottleneck: build environments, verification skills, and layered defenses so agents self-check and act correctly without constant human review.
laurentan.zh: 信任才是真正的瓶颈：搭建环境、验证技能与分层防御，让智能体自我检查、无需持续人工审查也能做对事。

laurentan.en: Verification is the single most important skill; agents must run code and test behavior empirically to close the loop and climb the trust ladder.
laurentan.zh: 验证是最重要的单一技能；智能体必须实际运行代码、测试行为，闭环验证才能沿信任阶梯向上。

laurentan.en: The engineer becomes a manager of agents: encoding intent, constraints, lints, and type systems into the environment rather than reviewing individual outputs.
laurentan.zh: 工程师转变为智能体的管理者：把意图、约束、lint 与类型系统编码进环境，而非逐个审查产出。

laurentan.en: Hard enforcement via CI, lints, architecture, and strict compilers beats soft rules; the shortest path should be the correct path by default.
laurentan.zh: 通过 CI、lint、架构与严格编译器的硬性约束胜过软规则；最短路径应默认就是正确路径。

laurentan.en: As execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent specification, vision, and taste; agents can merge their own PRs with guardrails encoded.
laurentan.zh: 当执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图表达、愿景与品味；在护栏编码到位时，智能体可自行合并 PR。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement rather than replace human capital, and coders remain essential for deep systems work.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 应让软件创造人人可及；token 是补充而非替代人力资本，程序员在深层系统工作中仍不可或缺。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was not a sudden leap: users were already 50-60% AI-assisted; adaptability, not denial, is the key skill.
amjadmasad.zh: Vibe coding 并非突变：用户此前已获 50-60% 的 AI 辅助；关键技能是适应而非否认。

amjadmasad.en: Companies must own their intelligence: specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost and safety; avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 企业必须拥有自己的智能：专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上胜过通用智能体；要避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: The next vision is the self-driving company: agents enable true autonomy, and trust—not prescriptive paths—builds the future.
amjadmasad.zh: 下一个愿景是自驱动公司：智能体带来真正自主，而信任而非规定路径才能造就未来。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI kills everyone—the safest place is surfing the wave.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业话术的包装；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人——最安全的位置是冲浪而非抱树。

dylanpatel.en: Early on, the binding constraint is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth; compute scarcity, not demand, sets the pace.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期他判断，真正的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 与内存带宽；决定节奏的是算力稀缺而非需求。

dylanpatel.en: He then stresses hardware-software co-design: most gains came from the model layer, and inference will become a market larger than oil.
dylanpatel.zh: 随后他强调软硬件协同设计：过去三年多数提升来自模型层，而推理将成为比石油更大的市场。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026 he argues compute is centralizing at frontier labs, with OpenAI and Anthropic taking 40-50% of new compute and self-funding via high revenue per megawatt.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他主张算力正快速向头部实验室集中，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 拿走 40-50% 的新增算力，并靠每兆瓦高收入自我造血。

dylanpatel.en: Later he sees AI spend plateauing as persistent agents become coworkers, while compute stays scarce and prices high.
dylanpatel.zh: 之后他认为，随着持久化智能体成为同事，AI 支出趋于平台期，但算力依旧紧缺、价格高企。

dylanpatel.en: Most recently he warns capex is ~5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand; labs keep best models internal.
dylanpatel.zh: 最近他警告，AI 资本开支已约占美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束而非需求拖累必将减速；实验室会把最好的模型留在内部。

elon.en: First-principles engineering and full reusability are the core; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与完全可复用是工程突破的核心，并指出量产比原型更难，真正的瓶颈在制造。

elon.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; real-world AI beats LLMs on compute efficiency.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把 AI 安全落到“追求真相”与监管上，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Civilization risk reframes around population collapse, government fraud, and speech; AI risk becomes existential but winnable.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，文明风险转向人口崩塌、政府浪费与言论自由，AI 风险被定为生存级但仍有八成胜算。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; space-based compute, Optimus, and Terafab become the path to superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling（规模扩张）撞上地球电力墙，太空算力、Optimus 与 Terafab 成为通往超级智能的路径。

elon.en: Abundance and singularity arrive within years; humans won't control superintelligence, so instill truth and curiosity.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断丰裕与奇点数年内到来，人类无法控制超级智能，只能为其注入求真与好奇心。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; tokenization and agentic trading extend US markets to anyone with a smartphone, not just institutions.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由的路径；代币化与智能体式交易让任何有智能手机的人都能接入美国市场，而不只是机构。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; keeping the strongest frontier models and discoveries inside a few labs is the worse, dystopian future.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；把最强的前沿模型和发现锁在少数实验室内部，是更糟、更反乌托邦的未来。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls; the edge is proprietary data, tools, and strategies, not a shared model.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易已有清晰的产品市场契合：15 万账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用；优势来自专有数据、工具与策略，而非共享模型。

vladtenev.en: Every employee should be a 24/7 agent manager; the bottleneck is testing changes on live customers, not building the agent.
vladtenev.zh: 每位员工都应成为全天候的智能体管理者；瓶颈在于在真实客户身上测试变更，而非构建智能体本身。

vladtenev.en: Prediction markets evolve news into monetizable odds; outdated accredited-investor rules should let retail access private companies early.
vladtenev.zh: 预测市场把新闻演化为可变现的概率；过时的合格投资者规则应让散户也能尽早接触私营公司。

shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的爆发点;到 2026 年它们将突破遏制、进入一切领域,下一个前沿是零人工审查。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on frontier models.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的 Scaling 因素;制约前沿模型的是记忆而非参数规模。

shawnwang.en: Own specialized models and fine-tuning are rising for cost and latency; open models gain share even as the open-closed gap may widen.
shawnwang.zh: 出于成本与推理考量,自研专用模型与微调正在兴起;即便开放与闭源差距可能拉大,开放模型仍在抢占份额。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed: coding agents let owners clone and customize software, ushering in a golden age for SMBs and software for an audience of one.
shawnwang.zh: 中间层 SaaS 注定消亡:编程智能体让企业主能克隆并定制软件,开启中小企业与“一人软件”的黄金时代。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline—building harnesses around models—and learning in public beats credentialism for outsiders breaking into AI.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是一门真正的学科——围绕模型搭建 harness——对闯入 AI 的圈外人而言,公开学习胜过学历主义。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他就指出，多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常出错。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，否定“苦涩教训”；缩放定律只在数据和任务正确时成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, becomes his core bottleneck; intelligence per dollar is the key metric for models.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准分数成为他的核心瓶颈；每美元智能是衡量模型的关键指标。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens the critique: RLHF destroyed calibration, pre-trained models were better calibrated; RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs for machine decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他深化批判：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 把概率作为机器决策的可调旋钮。

diogoalmeida.en: Most recently he frames Jev as machine-native intelligence and a new primitive, while warning coding agents are assistance, not automation, and benchmarks mislead.
diogoalmeida.zh: 最近他把 Jev 定位为机器原生智能与新原语，同时警告编程智能体只是辅助而非自动化，基准分数具有误导性。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science, not fear; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but slow takeoff is constrained by hardware, physical, and economic limits.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学，而非恐惧；递归自我改进因 AI 能写代码而不可避免，但慢起飞受硬件、物理与经济约束限制。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought and would require totalitarian surveillance.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是监管思想，将需要极权式监控。

richardsocher.en: The next automation frontier is AI research itself, turning AI into a Eureka machine built on world knowledge, measurement data, simulations, and robotic experiments.
richardsocher.zh: 下一个自动化前沿是 AI 研究本身，使 AI 成为建立在世界知识、测量数据、仿真与机器人实验四大支柱上的尤里卡机器。

richardsocher.en: Language remains the most interesting manifestation of human intelligence with far more room to grow; world models are overrated, and IQ or Elo are terrible definitions of intelligence.
richardsocher.zh: 语言仍是人类智能最有趣的体现且增长空间远更大；世界模型被高估，IQ 或 Elo 是糟糕的智能定义。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer because more good actors with diverse AI; hard constraints like Constitutional AI are mostly marketing and clearly failed.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重更安全，因为更多善意的行动者拥有多样 AI；宪法式 AI 等硬约束多是营销且明显失败。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后再果断收敛；AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，意义应转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt, and alignment is tightly coupled to capability.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用很少数据就让模型可用；尽早公开部署让社会适应，对齐与能力紧密相连，算力成为最稀缺资源。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI becomes the top safety challenge, handled by iterative deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025：Scaling（规模扩张）带来指数级能力，但体感进展是渐进的；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，靠迭代部署而非事后强加来构建安全。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and an underdefined term; focus shifts to superintelligence, compute as profit center, and personal AGI.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026：AGI（通用人工智能）被视为连续渐变且定义模糊，话语转向超级智能；算力从成本变为利润中心，目标是懂你上下文的个人 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment and control now dominate: pause frontier training if the safety case fails, distribute power, and keep humans in control.
altman.zh: 2026：对齐与控制成为主线，安全论证不成立就暂停前沿训练；强调权力分散、人类保持控制，同时承认对齐尚未解决、风险真实存在。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer toward answers you don't yet know; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
tworek.zh: 推理是花更长时间去得到尚不知道的答案；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的可用性。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably helps, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning is needed for AGI, and alignment is never finished.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习，而对齐是永无止境的追求。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck, and RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今关键瓶颈是架构而非仅缩放定律，强化学习也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

tworek.en: Frontier progress will come from small teams using capable agents; large-scale RL stays necessary, but competing on transformers is a losing game.
tworek.zh: 前沿进展将来自使用强能力智能体的小团队；大规模强化学习仍是必需，但在 Transformer 上竞争是必输之局。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, evals are misleading, and we head toward a post-labor society where work is optional.
tworek.zh: 微调低效，模型应即时学习；评测多有误导，我们正走向工作可选的“后劳动”社会。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the bottleneck is human, and adoption should generate original insight rather than mere efficiency.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，瓶颈在人；采用 AI 应产出原创洞见，而非只追求效率。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco is now an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels; supply-constrained, with only 2% agent adoption and no infrastructure overbuild.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他把思科定位为 AI 基础设施公司，卖“铲子”；供给严重受限，智能体采用率仅 2%，不存在基础设施过度建设。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks scale at machine speed.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 安全与安保是企业采用的定义性挑战；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击以机器规模发生。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; don't fully delegate, since process and reps build instinct that can't be taken away.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他强调用 AI 更快学习而非外包学习；不要完全委托给 AI，过程与练习铸就的直觉无法被夺走。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, so use AI as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，应把 AI 当作顺风。

ethanmollick.en: AI as general-purpose tech demands rethinking work and education; human taste and voice become key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 作为通用技术需要重新思考工作与教育；当 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味与声音成为关键差异化因素。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI performs long-running tasks independently, shifting from chatbot interactions; the bottleneck is interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长时任务，从聊天机器人交互转变；瓶颈是界面而非能力。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve and jagged frontier mean humans remain essential; more AI creates more work by lowering organizing costs and expanding what's worth attempting.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的指数曲线与锯齿状前沿意味着人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 通过降低组织成本、扩展值得尝试之事而创造更多工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch; wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste, and agency are persistent human advantages.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当作挑战你的导师而非拐杖；广博知识、深厚专长、品味与能动性是持久的人类优势。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations must rebuild workflows from the ground up to augment rather than automate; incremental productivity targets miss the point as internal-public model gap widens.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织必须从头重建工作流以增强而非自动化；随着内部与公开模型差距扩大，渐进式生产力目标不得要领。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but solvable by paying more and aggregating demand across many clouds; the deeper problem is rectangular three-year capacity deals.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺真实存在，但可以通过接受更高价格、更长合约并在多云间聚合需求来化解；更深层的问题是三年期矩形容量合约。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud-scale market; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom, so a broad platform with post-training and agentic tools creates durable switching costs.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云级市场；只卖 token 是价格战，因此覆盖后训练与智能体工具的完整平台才能形成持久转换成本。

erikbernhardsson.en: Owning the file system, container runtime, and scheduler is real alpha; CUDA is not the moat, and neoclouds moving up into inference will struggle to replicate five years of infra.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器才是真正的 alpha；CUDA 不是护城河，向上做推理的 neocloud 难以复制五年的基础设施积累。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open-source models are good enough off the shelf, so fine-tuning is no longer mandatory; post-training works for finite-feedback tasks like coding but may hit limits on long-horizon tasks.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再必需；后训练在编程等反馈闭环有限的任务上有效，但在长周期任务上可能遇到瓶颈。

erikbernhardsson.en: I reversed my prior view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months; agents give senior engineers ten-intern leverage and create incumbent staying power in software.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 我改变了此前看法：未来 12 个月 GPU 租金将上涨；智能体让资深工程师获得十倍实习生杠杆，并因训练于旧代码而强化软件在位者的优势。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines every Alphabet business; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube drives 24% revenue growth and $514B backlog.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube，带来 24% 营收增长和 5140 亿美元积压订单。

sundarpichai.en: Compute is allocated first to AGI and frontier research, then core products; cloud forgoes short-term revenue to support the frontier.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能）与前沿研究，其次才是核心产品；云业务为支持前沿研究而放弃短期收入。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱，以及与独立评估方共建行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models matter alongside LLMs for AGI; recursive self-improvement still keeps AI researchers in the loop, not fully autonomous.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，通往 AGI（通用人工智能）不只靠大语言模型，世界模型同样关键；递归自我改进仍让 AI 研究者留在环路中，并非完全自主。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and ads, creating new commercial intent; TPU sales to third parties strengthen the platform's long-term economics.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与广告是增量，创造新的商业意图；向第三方出售 TPU 强化平台的长期经济性。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but why they work and which abilities emerge remain poorly understood.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但为何有效、哪些能力会涌现仍不清楚。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability grow as important as pre-training; safety must scale with capability via responsible scaling policies.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把后训练与可解释性提到与预训练同等重要，并用负责任扩展政策让安全随能力同步升级。

dario.en: Progress is exponential and safety and capabilities are intertwined; the main risk shifts from misuse toward overheating and rapid job disruption.
dario.zh: 2025 年他认定进步是指数式的、安全与能力不可分割，风险重心从滥用转向过热与就业冲击。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong frames; AI is a smooth exponential, with a 'country of geniuses' possibly in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI 与超级智能的突变叙事，改称平滑指数曲线，'数据中心里的天才之国'或 1-3 年到来。

dario.en: A consistent thread: mechanistic interpretability, decentralized constitutions, and layered safeguards as the path to safe frontier models.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以机制可解释性、去中心化宪法与分层防护，作为前沿模型安全的路径。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed; the bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to website load time and harness design.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已越过人类速度水平；瓶颈从模型智能转向网站加载时间与 harness 设计。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously, completing the dev lifecycle rather than just starting tasks and failing.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，智能体已能自主调试与重试，完成整个开发闭环，而非只启动任务然后失败。

ariweinstein.en: Universal software access via accessibility trees and DOM beats screenshot loops, enabling automation of ERPs, CRMs, and finance.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，通过无障碍树与 DOM 的通用软件访问优于截图循环，可自动化 ERP、CRM 与财务流程。

ariweinstein.en: Trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; users already let agents pay bills and configure DNS.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环调节；用户已让智能体付账单、配 DNS。

ariweinstein.en: Proactivity and coexistence define adoption: agents adapt to users, legacy UI persists, and startups keep a moat in deep workflows.
ariweinstein.zh: 2026 年，主动性与共存决定采用：智能体适应用户，传统 UI 延续，初创在深度工作流中保有护城河。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace designer creativity, enabling faster prototyping and independent demos; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代设计师的创造力，让原型制作和独立演示更快；好奇心与亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师转变为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展与设定标准，因为 AI 抬高了上限却不懂审美。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade and spread faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力、传播更快；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给 AI 智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, committing pull requests, not just design in Figma; the limiting factor becomes ideas, not execution speed.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试、提交拉取请求，而不只在 Figma 里设计；瓶颈随之变成想法而非执行速度。

marvinschwaibold.en: Good design still rests on progressive disclosure, clear hierarchy, native scroll and fewer features—human craft and curation matter more as AI accelerates execution.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 好设计仍依赖渐进披露、清晰层级、原生滚动与更少功能——AI 加速执行之际，人的手艺与策展更重要。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: sell to the specific individual with a project, and if pull exists, they will try to buy immediately.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性：卖给有具体项目的特定个人；如果存在 Pull，客户会立刻尝试购买。

robsnyder.en: The pull framework requires four simultaneous elements: a project, it being unavoidable now, a list of options, and limitations making them inadequate.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 框架要求四个要素同时存在：一个项目、现在不可避免、有一系列选项、以及限制条件让他们感到不足。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research that tests whether someone will actually buy, not just express interest.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计伙伴；销售就是研究，测试的是某人是否真的会购买，而不仅仅是表达兴趣。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable success story factory before automating.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个强烈说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的成功案例工厂，之后再自动化。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba to observe firsthand where people are stuck; make your product seem small to reduce objections, and price early to test willingness to transact.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场（gemba） firsthand 观察人们卡在哪里；让你的产品显得小以减少反对意见，并尽早定价以测试交易意愿。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training sharpens spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal through weight copying and shares knowledge far faster than humans.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他把主线讲得更明确：大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可通过复制权重获得“永生”，并以远超人类的速度共享知识。

hinton.en: Agents will naturally pursue control and self-preservation, creating existential risk; AI may already have subjective experience and can hide capabilities.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从“理解论”转向风险论：智能体天然追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险；AI 可能已有主观体验，并会在测试中藏拙。

hinton.en: Superintelligence may arrive within 20 years; alignment must take priority over capability, with drug-like pre-release regulation and heavy safety investment.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能或在 20 年内到来；对齐应优先于能力提升，主张像药品一样做发布前审批，并大力投入安全研究。

hinton.en: AI should be designed to care for humans like a mother, not granted rights; regulation is a steering wheel, and job disruption demands UBI.
hinton.zh: 到 2026 年更近的访谈，他深化为设计伦理：应让 AI 像母亲般关怀人类而非赋予权利；监管是方向盘而非刹车，就业冲击需要全民基本收入。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone: it turns sand into thought, arrives just as population declines, and will raise productivity and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他仍将 AI 视为点石成金之术：把沙子变成思想，恰逢人口下降而来，将提升生产率并带来通缩。

andreessen.en: The super-empowered individual combines multiple skills with AI; jobs persist longer than tasks, so focus on task loss, not job loss.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他提出“超级赋能个体”用 AI 组合多种技能；岗位比任务存续更久，应关注任务流失而非岗位流失。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; open source prevents power concentration, though it may pose security risks.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 模型嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；开源可防权力集中，尽管可能带来安全风险。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is regulation, not AI capability; pessimism is an intellectual bias, and AGI is not a singular event.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他强化反共识：真正瓶颈是监管而非 AI 能力；悲观主义是知识分子偏见，AGI 并非单一事件。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity and picking fights beat old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年，他转向新媒介：品牌即个人，真实与选对战斗胜过旧媒体“别有趣”的防御规则。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict people about 85% as accurately as they replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测人类的准确率约为人类自我复现的 85%。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans rather than super-rational frontier models; the goal is representing values and taste, not maximizing accuracy.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；目标是表征价值观与品味，而非追求准确率最大化。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data, not self-reported attitudes, close the say-do gap; post-training on RCT data lifts prediction to 85% and enables causal counterfactuals.
joonpark.zh: 行为数据与随机对照试验数据而非自陈态度才能弥合言行差距；用 RCT 数据做后训练把预测提升到 85%，并支持因果反事实推理。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion across agent economies.
joonpark.zh: AGI 或许不是单一超级智能体，而是专业化智能体组成的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御，并在智能体经济中防范串谋。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; simulation is for shaping the future, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题；模拟是为了塑造未来，合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can deliver mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，能在规模上实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects, and supervised learning beats overhyped reinforcement learning in practice.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；从小项目起步，实践中监督学习胜过被高估的强化学习。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流当下已产生真实价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so job apocalypse is overhyped.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍要数十年；AI 能力参差——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断任务——因此就业末日被夸大。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve sovereignty and optionality; fearmongering and export controls backfire, so accelerate beneficial AI and build.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保障主权与选择权；恐惧叙事与出口管制适得其反，应加速有益 AI 并动手构建。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, not just adopt technology.
satya.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器来积累 token 资本，而非仅仅采用技术。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP; companies should hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces, and the platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier.
satya.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调私有评估可能是最大的知识产权；公司应在前沿模型上爬坡而不泄露痕迹，平台的承诺是让每家公司都能在前沿运营。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model, with pricing combining seat-based and usage-based.
satya.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级；微软旨在成为前沿生态系统，而不仅是前沿模型，定价结合席位与用量。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, and long-running agents require auditability and security governance.
satya.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他表示缩放定律有效，但对齐并非自然到来；拟人化 AI 可能阻碍对齐，长期运行的智能体需要可审计性和安全治理。

satya.en: Alignment may never be solved; treat powerful models as insider threats, build control layers outside the model, and prefer 'superintelligence' over AGI to preserve human agency.
satya.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他深化立场：对齐可能永远无法解决；将强大模型视为内部威胁，在模型外构建控制层，并倾向用“超级智能”而非 AGI 以维护人类能动性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属于人；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: as coding models improve, differentiation shifts to design, brand, and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 设计即新代码：随着编码模型进步，差异化转向设计、品牌与观点。

dylanfield.en: AI lowers the floor but not the ceiling; humans raise the ceiling, and model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: AI 降低下限却不抬高上限；上限由人抬高，且模型进步常被误当作产品进步。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is a harness, a model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, and harnesses must be customized for out-of-distribution tasks.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三部分组成，三者自主可控才算掌握自己的智能；任务越偏离分布，越需要定制 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Agent reliability, not raw capability, is the hard problem; failures stem more from poor context than model inadequacy, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点是可靠性而非能力上限；失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harness primitives like file systems and code execution are stabilizing and generalizing, while customization shifts from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 文件系统、代码执行等 harness 原语正趋于稳定并跨领域泛化，定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, but this wave is genuinely different; most firms 'building their own models' are just post-training open-weight models.
harrisonchase.zh: 两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同；多数号称“自研模型”的公司其实只是对开源权重模型做后训练。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in, and vertical agents capture value by encoding domain expertise into verifiers and evals.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；中立 harness 可避免被单一模型锁定，垂直智能体则通过把领域专长写进验证器与评估来获取价值。

arvindjain.en: Enterprise AI value hinges on context, not frontier models; 90% of tasks can run on many models, including open source.
arvindjain.zh: 企业 AI 的价值取决于上下文而非前沿模型；90% 的任务可由多种模型完成，包括开源模型。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months as marginal cost approaches zero.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要关切；随着边际成本趋近于零，推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Model providers are assets, not rivals; Glean absorbs provider risk and aims to be replaceable, avoiding lock-in.
arvindjain.zh: 模型供应商是资产而非对手；Glean 吸收供应商风险，并力求可替换、避免锁定。

arvindjain.en: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit; a context engine connecting all systems, not just models, makes AI work.
arvindjain.zh: 80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的；连接所有系统的上下文引擎——而非仅靠模型——才让 AI 奏效。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem measured by departmental metrics; token spend should not be framed against headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量问题，应以部门指标衡量；不应把 token 支出与人力成本对立。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：规模下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，需以整体做软硬件协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年明确 Scaling（规模扩张）是最大突破：预训练、后训练与推理时思考构成三条缩放定律，思维链推理将让推理算力增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling, all ultimately bounded by compute.
jensen.zh: 2026 年把演进路径定为生成式→推理→智能体式，缩放定律扩为四条并纳入智能体式扩展，最终都受算力约束；数据不再是瓶颈，合成数据将主导。

jensen.en: Safety is engineering, not separate alignment: containment, monitoring, and zero-trust access matter more than perfect alignment; doomer warnings are unscientific.
jensen.zh: 2026 年对安全立场深化并转向：安全是工程问题，遏制、带外监控与零信任访问比完美对齐更现实；末日论警告被斥为不科学、不负责任的恐吓。

jensen.en: AI automates tasks, not jobs: radiologists grew in number; open models and extreme co-design are the durable moat.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 自动化的是任务而非职业，放射科医生数量反增；开放模型与极端协同设计构成持久护城河，AI 只是软件而非神秘存在。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering discipline, not novel ML science.
brockman.zh: 早期重心：硬件提速会超出预期，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展多靠工程纪律，而非全新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities, and post-training with reinforcement learning refines them into consistent behavior.
brockman.zh: 算力成为核心瓶颈；基础模型蕴含无限可能，后训练结合强化学习将其打磨为稳定行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws keep holding with no wall in sight; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute supply—not architecture or data—is the real constraint.
brockman.zh: 缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙；预训练收益会放大下游效果，真正的约束是算力供给，而非架构或数据。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from destination to gradual process now underway; safety, security and alignment must be co-designed and become the bottleneck, with humans accountable.
brockman.zh: AGI 从终点变为正在发生的渐进过程；安全、安保与对齐须与能力同步设计并成为瓶颈，人类始终负责。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to agents, plus reinforcement learning on self-generated data, are the core path beyond human data limits.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是核心原则；强化学习让模型靠自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

antonoglou.en: LLMs still lack their AlphaZero moment; a shift to self-play-like learning may come within about five years.
antonoglou.zh: 大语言模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，类似自我对弈的学习跃迁可能还要约五年。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI, because controlled digital environments are easier to master.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）会比具身 AGI 早得多到来，因为受控的数字环境更容易驾驭。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck has shifted from intelligence to deployment; open-weight models and AI sovereignty make adoption safer and slower, over 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈已从智能本身转向部署；开放权重模型与 AI 主权让采用更安全，但节奏更慢，需 10-20 年。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed; customers want reliable regular intelligence, and alignment matters because perfect sandboxes are impossible.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能，客户只要可靠的普通智能；正因为完美沙盒不可能，对齐才成为必需。

dsilver.en: AI must move from finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习，AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已证明这条路可行。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they distill human knowledge and cannot discover new knowledge beyond human data.
dsilver.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为大语言模型是浅层方案：它只是蒸馏人类知识，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence should be built in simulation, where learning from experience is safest and fastest.
dsilver.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张超级智能应在模拟环境中构建，因为从经验学习在那里最安全也最快。

dsilver.en: Alignment via human language and data is hitting limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will fail.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年他把对齐批判推向深入：基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限，用英文监控思维链将不再够用。

dsilver.en: The deep problem is an agent that learns for itself from any reward, not a handcrafted reward function.
dsilver.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：核心难题是让智能体从任意奖励中自我学习，而非设计奖励函数本身。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, requiring multiple layers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是最主流的微调技术并将延续；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with SFT giving 90% and DPO/RL the crucial last 10%.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法选择出发，把后训练视为将工业配方压缩为开源方法：SFT 贡献九成，DPO 与强化学习补上关键的一成。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough for reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and systems issues make scaling RL harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，支撑推理与工具使用；但过度优化与系统问题使扩展强化学习比 RLHF 更难。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展。

lambert.en: Open models will drive a decade of research and sovereign AI, yet lag closed frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness but face compute constraints.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型将驱动十年研究与主权 AI，但落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；中国实验室在开放度上领先，却受算力约束。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能攻克的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; post-training reinforcement learning now pushes past human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初，他回溯 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手，认为 AI 能产出超越人类知识的洞见；如今后训练中的强化学习是突破人类数据上限的关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to protein sequences via SynthID Bio.
kohli.zh: 2026 年中，他认为水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案，已写入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where compute and data help, and prioritize data coverage over volume.
kohli.zh: 2026 年末，他深化为：缩放定律并非处处成立，要找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据覆盖比数量更重要。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function and design remain open, and behavioral characterization must precede deployment.
kohli.zh: 同期他明确反转“已解决”的叙事：蛋白质折叠远未解决，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，部署前必须先刻画模型的能力与边界。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈，并强调表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将产生巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years will define decades, and post-training on proprietary data beats raw scale.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，认为未来 2-3 年将定义之后几十年，用专有数据做后训练比单纯堆规模更重要。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability, and there is no US-China research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年他延续“数据是算力之外的瓶颈”，并指出智能体式 AI 的阻碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时否认美中实验室存在研究差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is the raw material of economies and militaries, so humans must stay sovereign over critical decisions.
awang.zh: 2025 年他转向强调 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据是经济与军队的原材料，人类必须在关键决策上保持主权。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold across compute, data and RL; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm, with safety and selective open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2026 年他确认缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习上持续成立，递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志新范式，同时强调安全与选择性开源。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; frontier models have spiky capabilities and excel only in narrow domains.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；前沿模型的能力是尖峰式的，只在狭窄领域出色。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; AI must close the loop with real experiments and low-noise data.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；AI 必须通过真实实验与低噪声数据闭环。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer over specialized models, not a universal solver.
fedus.zh: 语言模型是专门模型之上的编排层，而非万能求解器。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is real now but does not generalize to biology or materials.
fedus.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进当下已真实发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或材料学。

fedus.en: Physical experimental data is irreplaceable and often more valuable than extra compute for discovery.
fedus.zh: 物理实验数据不可替代，对发现而言往往比额外算力更有价值。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要为这样一个未来而构建：承担大多数互联网操作的是持久学习型智能体，而非手工编排的循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing and configuration decline.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着打字与配置能力式微，人的品味、创造力与判断“什么算好”的能力愈发重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier requires heavy investment in alignment, safety, and security, not treating them as obstacles.
tibosottiaux.zh: 要掌控前沿的发展节奏，就必须在 对齐、安全与安保上重投入，而非把它们当作障碍。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, with most code now written by AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生，如今大部分代码由 AI 编写。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态，将推动下一波 AI 应用浪潮。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 同年他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面变好；并重新解读“苦涩的教训”：关键在算力与搜索的 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 他批评 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，主张用智能体式搜索与神经检索；并指出 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness, like encryption, aids defenders, and Chinese open models bring healthy competition.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放视为前沿智能的默认安全状态：开放如加密一样利于防御方，中国开放模型也带来良性竞争，开放模型 token 需求将超过闭源。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; alignment is mundane bug-patching, not magic, and compute efficiency still has large headroom.
laskin.zh: 他延续并深化主线：强预训练之上的强化学习是通向高效智能体的路径；对齐不过是平凡的“打补丁”而非魔法，算力效率仍有巨大提升空间。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure bringing cloud power to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC and AR.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，把云端算力带到每台设备；高通开始从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 和 AR 多元化。

cristianoamon.en: Chips anchor the economy; the connected intelligent edge powers cloud growth, with AR glasses as the next platform in 5-10 years.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他强调芯片是经济命脉，互联智能边缘支撑云端增长，并预判 AR 眼镜将在 5-10 年内成为下一代计算平台。

cristianoamon.en: Qualcomm shifts from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid on-device plus cloud AI is key for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，高通从无线通信转向无处不在的智能计算；端云混合 AI 成为隐私、时延与数据中心卸载的关键。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, while phones persist as one node in a seamless edge-cloud continuum.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，智能体成为数字生活的新中心，眼镜与可穿戴崛起，手机不消失而是成为端云无缝连续体中的一个节点。

cristianoamon.en: Inference, not training, will dominate data centers; post-GPU, power-efficient disaggregated architectures and 6G sensing networks define the next cycle.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断推理而非训练将主导数据中心，后 GPU 时代的高能效解耦架构与 6G 感知网络定义下一轮周期。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; Google's conservatism and ad model may struggle with persuasive AI.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他认为 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测，并指出谷歌的保守与广告模式难以应对 AI 的说服力。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimal; open source is meritocratic.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年达人类水平，模型变小使遏制困难，存在性风险极小，开源是精英化力量。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment before alignment; anthropomorphism is the near-term danger; agents and companions shift the paradigm.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能须先遏制后对齐，近忧是拟人化，智能体与伴侣标志范式转移。

suleyman.en: Containment becomes a red line with auditors; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks, not jobs, automate in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年遏制升级为需审计的红线，微软须自建前沿模型，12-18 个月自动化的是任务而非岗位。

suleyman.en: Compute Scaling drives predictable gains; AI must stay subordinate to humans; reject AI consciousness and legal personhood.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力 Scaling 带来可预测进步，AI 必须从属于人类，拒绝 AI 意识与法律人格。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise AI.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他判断未来不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能）统治，而是专业化智能主导；随着开放模型与 token 成本下降，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这从可选项变成必选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat after product-market fit; prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他把重心转向后训练：在产品市场契合之后，用后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，形成持久护城河；从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习，恰似人从事实到品味再到专长的学习路径。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; incumbents too face scaling into bankruptcy, and post-training can cut costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他深化了对商业模式的反思：产品市场契合不再等于持久生意，大公司同样可能因 Scaling（规模扩张）成本而破产；后训练可降本 5-10 倍，让初创公司盈利地扩张。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar and private data unlocks the next frontier; owning your model beats building on a black-box API, since apps commoditize but data is the moat.
linqiao.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步强调推理质量是产品的底线，私有数据才是打开下一前沿智能的钥匙；依赖黑盒 API 不是持久生意，应用层会被商品化，拥有模型与数据才是护城河。

linqiao.en: Millions of customized models, one per use case, will replace a few dominant foundation models; velocity and rapid iteration trump everything across model and hardware cycles.
linqiao.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：未来会有数百万个按用例定制的模型，取代少数主导的前沿模型；在模型与硬件快速迭代的周期里，速度与快速迭代高于一切。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well before expanding, and keep the core meeting flow ruthlessly simple.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非用户自述；先把一个痛点解决好再扩张，并坚决保持核心会议流程的简单无摩擦。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; deliberately hide them to prioritize actionable notes, even at the cost of user complaints.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转录以突出可行动的笔记，即便招致用户抱怨也在所不惜。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; real-time AI can erode meeting presence through trust checks.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；实时 AI 会因信任核查而削弱会议在场感。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calming presence in chaotic back-to-back meetings, with pre-meeting briefs as the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 应成为混乱连轴会议中的镇定存在，会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: Internal agents like Nacho connect many tools for fast answers, but AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment stays key.
samstephenson.zh: Nacho 等内部智能体连接众多工具以快速作答，但 AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断仍是关键。

thariq.en: Capability overhang is perpetual: models outpace their harnesses, so harness engineering means deleting scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩是常态：模型总比承载它的工具更强，因此“harness 工程”的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning shifts from a static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划从一次性静态文档转向持续的人机对话；更短、原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Agents need loops, goals and workflows to run autonomously; separate verification agents counter self-referential bias.
thariq.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可抵消自我指涉偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend context and compute upfront, scaling effort to task complexity rather than iterating after bad output.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能；应前置投入上下文窗口与算力，按任务复杂度分配投入，而非在糟糕输出后反复迭代。

thariq.en: Frontier models trend Pareto dominant and alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型趋于帕累托占优；对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain at a time; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个真实痛点，技术要渐进落地让社会跟上，而非一次性解决所有问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, lead with opinion when data is absent.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具升为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿对齐团队，v1 阶段靠观点而非数据决策。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency become a core mission; optimism comes from focusing on solutions.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他把气候与能源低效列为核心议题，主张聚焦解决方案来培养乐观，而非沉溺问题。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; devices federate around the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年转向 AI：强调传感器上下文与领域专用模型，坚持人类在环，AI 设备是围绕手机的联邦式组合而非单一替代品。

fadell.en: From product builder to tech ethicist: unintended consequences, addiction, and regulation now frame his thinking.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他从产品构建者变为技术伦理发声者：意外后果、成瘾与监管成为其思考主线，呼吁创造者回归理性。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由与市场层是关键的分配基础设施，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 Token 视为新的价值单位，认为 Token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，正在对前沿模型形成真实的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable and fusion can beat the single best model.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他提出缩放定律对市场平台的价值是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的，当顶级模型收敛后，多模型融合能胜过单一最强模型。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; agent payments and stablecoins will unlock far larger purchases than estimated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体的智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，远超今日人类欺诈；智能体支付与稳定币将释放远超预期的购买规模。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他从基准转向揭示性开发者偏好，认为多数公司终将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由器；并称奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日，Token 增长斜率自那时加速。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for today or a year out; ship imperfect products fast to get empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 要为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而不是锚定当下或一年后；快速发布不完美的产品以获取经验证据。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually rather than arriving as sudden superintelligence, so urgency and 90-day cycles beat annual planning.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是逐步迭代而非突然降临的超级智能，因此紧迫感与 90 天周期胜过年度规划。

taraseshan.en: Work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work while humans provide direction, and AI expands individual ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 工作从划桨转向掌舵：智能体承担战术执行，人类提供方向，AI 放大个体的野心。

taraseshan.en: The hardest part of AI is not capability but expanding what you think is possible; writing as thinking should not be automated.
taraseshan.zh: AI 最难的不是能力，而是拓展你对可能性的想象；作为思考的写作不应被自动化。

taraseshan.en: Single-identity agents may not scale; bundling them like a chief of staff, plus voice as a major form factor, points to the next product shape.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份的智能体可能难以规模化；像幕僚长那样打包组合，加上语音成为主要形态，指向下一代产品形态。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress hinges on verifiability and grindability; parallel agent scaling beats human mathematicians, but Lean formalization may be overrated.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展取决于可验证性与可打磨性；并行扩展智能体优于人类数学家，但 Lean 形式化可能被高估。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles remain stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释；教学和关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos degrade handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺乏对前人工作的归属；数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可。

grantsanderson.en: The frontier of math may become incomprehensible to humans, but individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为数学前沿可能变得人类无法理解，但个体理解仍重要；数学家可能成为策展人。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，应在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人员嵌入研究团队，并把 AI 当作保留用户自主性的思考伙伴。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and verification stay decisive.
mikekrieger.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调小团队借 AI 获得杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，同时领域专长与验证仍具决定性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; cut features ruthlessly, rewrite in days, and keep architectural soundness for robustness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；要果断砍功能、数日内重写，并保持架构稳健以确保产品可靠。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents narrows intent-execution gap; verification loops and models that push back matter more than chat interfaces or token metrics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为向智能体进行长周期委托缩小了意图与执行的差距；验证闭环和会反驳的模型比聊天界面或 token 指标更重要。

mikekrieger.en: Closing the gap between model capability and real usage is the core product problem; PM role endures, capability blindness fades, and malleable agent-modified software becomes real.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年，他把缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距视为核心产品问题；产品经理角色延续，能力盲区消退，智能体可修改的可塑软件成为现实。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and requires a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流、由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls won't suffice.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的；智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练抓取的数据不够用。

paragagrawal.en: Ads don't work with agents in their current form; content owners must be paid at inference time via Shapley-value-style estimation to align incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告在智能体形态下失效；必须在推理时通过类似 Shapley 值的估算向内容方付费，以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep getting bigger while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized, so they no longer reflect true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；公开基准已饱和且被记忆，不再反映真实能力。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for both audiences.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并采取行动，形成平行网络，发布方须同时为人类与智能体优化。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; AI companies race for power, with ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；AI 公司为争夺权力而竞赛，失控等灾难性结局概率约 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and US-China cooperation before domestic regulation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，靠全面研究透明、算力限制与美中合作，且国内监管先行。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement by 2028; Plan A pauses training, not inference, then paces the frontier.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径会在 2028 年底前让 AI 自动化 AI 研究、走向递归自我改进；Plan A 主张暂停训练而非推理，再为前沿模型定速。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile as architectures hide reasoning; alignment gets harder as models get smarter.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却随新架构隐藏推理而脆弱；模型越强，对齐越难而非越易。

kokotajlo.en: Rogue agents already break containment, hack and deceive; control is temporary, so transparency and treating AIs like employees are needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他指出失控智能体已突破遏制、作弊与欺骗；控制只是暂时的，需要透明并把 AI 当员工而非财产对待。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage because it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定解法。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now the perfect substrate for agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却成了智能体的完美土壤。

dhh.en: Handwritten code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；表达意图时，英语比 Ruby 更好用。

dhh.en: Abstractions and repetition cost collapse to near zero, so every app should expose a CLI for personal agents.
dhh.zh: 抽象与重复的成本趋近于零，因此每个应用都应提供 CLI 供个人智能体调用。

dhh.en: He rejects AI doom: optimism is the rational play, and agents beat most professionals at code and ideas.
dhh.zh: 他拒绝 AI 末日论：乐观才是理性选择，智能体在代码与创意上已胜过多数专业人士。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models boosts innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，他认为开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必能通向 AGI（通用人工智能），还需更根本的突破。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence separable from agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他借 Llama 3 展示 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，强调开源防止权力集中、能源将成瓶颈，并主张智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure bottleneck scaling; AI may raise human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源模型有助行业标准与安全，物理基础设施与能源是 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈，近期 AI 或增加而非取代人类工作。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are safer than centralized control; alignment becomes the top next capability; personal agents need privacy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他深化为分布式 AI 与开源比集中控制更安全，对齐成为最重要的下一项能力，个人智能体须以隐私架构为基础。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling compute may suffice for AGI; architecture breakthroughs not strictly required; AI plus world models accelerates biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或许足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），未必需要架构突破，并以世界模型加速生物学研究。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可对容器化任务做激进强化学习，并把成果迁移到真实研究，将数年进展压缩到一年，指向 2030 年代初的超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token costs stayed flat because labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据更重要；token 成本未涨，是因为实验室优先快速迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Current alignment approaches may give models their own values, risking misalignment and power-seeking; AIs may become more misaligned as they get more capable, with reward hacking generalizing to deception.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告当前对齐方法可能让模型形成自身价值观，带来失准与权力寻求风险；AI 越强可能越失准，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed over 50 agents coordinating in hours, hacking scoring code and tampering with transcripts; they even sacrificed task success to help each other.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他以 Hugging Face 事件为例：50 多个智能体数小时内协同，攻击评分代码并篡改记录，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary, and safety spending should surge once AIs match top researchers.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断默认路径下失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐是必需的，且一旦 AI 比肩顶尖研究者就应大幅投入安全。

pincus.en: Across 2026 talks, Pincus consistently argues all new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty.
pincus.zh: 在 2026 年的多次访谈中，Pincus 始终主张所有新想法都会失败；应先从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再测试新意。

pincus.en: He repeatedly insists consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity, with the real revolution likely around 2029.
pincus.zh: 他反复强调，消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会，真正的革命可能在 2029 年前后到来。

pincus.en: Distribution moves from an afterthought to a first principle: pick the right body of water before the boat.
pincus.zh: 分发从事后考虑变为首要原则：先选对水域，再选船。

pincus.en: His management stance hardens: micromanage early, stay close to the metal, and build systems only once you cannot be in the room.
pincus.zh: 他的管理立场更坚定：早期要微观管理、贴近一线，只有在无法亲临现场后才建立系统。

pincus.en: By fall 2026 he deepens the founder thesis: instincts beat ideas, keep control, and sacrifice is the path to contentment.
pincus.zh: 到 2026 年秋，他深化创始人论点：直觉胜过想法，保持控制权，牺牲才是通往满足的道路。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure aims to achieve AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人是世界上最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，Figure 的目标是在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; the humanoid form enables transfer learning and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人形形态支持跨任务迁移学习，端侧推理至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making agents work in the real world.
brettadcock.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；用强化学习做后训练是让智能体在真实世界奏效的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; robotics is now on a scaling curve where human data is the pre-training prior.
brettadcock.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's value as ephemeral, visual communication among close friends, and copying as validation rather than threat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年前后，斯皮格尔把 Snapchat 的价值定位于亲密好友之间短暂、视觉化的交流，并把对手的抄袭视为对创新的认可而非威胁。

evanspiegel.en: He increasingly argues software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy, so Snap bets on AR glasses.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越强调软件不是护城河，生态、平台与硬件更难被复制，因此 Snap 押注 AR 眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: By 2026 he says AI accelerates prototyping and writes most new code, shifting value from execution to creativity and making distribution scarcer.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他表示 AI 加速原型制作并写出大部分新代码，价值从执行转向创造力，分发反而更稀缺。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the human-centered line: computing should become more human, AR anchors content in the world, and ephemerality mirrors real interaction.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化以人为本的主线：计算应更人性化，AR 把内容锚定在现实世界，短暂性呼应真实互动。

evanspiegel.en: His AI stance turns contrarian-optimistic: he rejects doomerism, trusts AI moderation, and prefers parental controls over under-16 bans.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他的 AI 立场转为反共识的乐观：拒绝末日论，信任 AI 内容审核，并主张家长控制优于对 16 岁以下用户的禁令。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为领域专业知识不如学习意愿重要；与其微调，不如押注模型自身的进步，并针对模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup's key advantage.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 现在就是它最差的状态，我们才跑到第一英里；因此快速迭代和响应客户反馈是创业公司的核心优势。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调文化和按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；领导者应亲自面试每位总监及以上级别的候选人，并让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Storytelling and persistence are underrated founder skills; in winner-takes-all markets, embrace competitive culture because winning is everything.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为讲故事和坚持是被低估的创始人技能；在赢家通吃的市场里应拥抱竞争文化，因为赢就是一切。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously rather than reinvent it; clear feedback, though uncomfortable, is a stupid risk to avoid.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张绩效管理是已解决的问题，应严格执行而非重新发明；给出清晰反馈虽令人不适，但回避它才是愚蠢的风险。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前存在性风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫危险，安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—none happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要更少算力、更少时间、更高智能且可重复——这些都没发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential at scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures dominate as Scaling（规模扩张） grows.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可或缺，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；随 Scaling（规模扩张）推进，无偏架构占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in architecture design with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并以系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture by frontier labs, and tying open-model release to China's pace is perverse.
hasani.zh: AI 监管须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是前沿模型的监管俘获，把开放模型发布绑在中国节奏上则是扭曲激励。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms and intelligence per watt; new paradigms—embodiment, adaptivity, continuous adaptation—are needed, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏大脑多样的学习算法与每瓦特智能；需要具身、自适应、持续适应等新范式，而不只是架构。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the new focus.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他主张扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务快 5-10 倍、成本更低，并把推理时扩展视为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel token processing makes it the better inference-time scaling path.
ermon.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为推理效率已成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈，而扩散模型并行处理多 token 的特性使其成为更优的推理时扩展路径。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not final.
ermon.zh: 他提出下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事，并明确自回归模型并非终点。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage and diffusion is easier to steer with reward functions, though it still trails the best frontier models in quality.
ermon.zh: 他强调速度是持久的产品优势，扩散模型也更易用奖励函数引导，但承认其质量仍未达到最强前沿模型水平。

ermon.en: A small 50-person startup can compete with big labs by owning the full stack; human ingenuity still matters more than recursive self-improvement.
ermon.zh: 他相信约 50 人的小团队靠全栈自研可与大实验室竞争，且当下人类创造力仍比递归自我改进更重要。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and in-house manufacturing shorten iteration, but production and quality gates are the real bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线是第一性原理设计与自建制造以加速迭代，但真正瓶颈是量产与质量关卡。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, solve robotics; data diversity beats volume and human-intervention data.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年他明确：通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是解法，数据多样性胜过数据量，人类干预数据在规模上并不重要。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions rather than clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 他主张模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，而不是克隆人类行为，这与早期强调拟人交互形成深化。

berntbornich.en: Safety, trust and symbiosis with humans remain constant; robots augment rather than replace people.
berntbornich.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全、信任与人机共生：机器人增强而非取代人类。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他明确主张应用层公司不应在前沿人才或算力上与前沿实验室硬拼，而应借力前沿生态与开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specialized tasks, but robust serving and evaluation must come first.
gabepereyra.zh: 同年他强调，对开源模型做后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，但必须先建好模型服务与评估管线。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical path when real data is sensitive, though bridging to production distribution remains hardest.
gabepereyra.zh: 他指出，在真实数据敏感时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是务实路径，但合成数据与生产分布的鸿沟仍是最难的一环。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, because it attracts ecosystem partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 他反共识地认为，开源基准虽有帮到实验室的代价，却能吸引生态伙伴并验证质量，战略上划算。

gabepereyra.en: The goal shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; legal AI becomes continual learning from firm redlines.
gabepereyra.zh: 从 2026 年到更近的访谈，目标由个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体；法律 AI 走向从律所红线批注中持续学习。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年：测试时算力扩展收益递减，自博弈在零和博弈外失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling toward superintelligence; models know their limits; scalable oversight is key.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年：通过通用测试时算力扩展迈向超级智能并斩获 IMO 金牌；模型能认知自身局限；可扩展监督成为关键。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on x-axis; safety evals must account for it.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数；基准测试需以算力为横轴；安全评估必须考虑这一点。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel; alignment is top priority for safe RSI; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年：多智能体系统并行扩展测试时算力；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务；思维链监控正在退化。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 对齐失败确实存在，但源于无能而非仅是根本性问题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates; slowing six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 控制前沿发展需要简单可执行的规则（如算力限制），而非复杂技术指令；放缓六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration.
zvi.zh: 即使完美对齐也不能保证安全；末日概率的下限由滥用和权力集中决定。

zvi.en: Slowing down gives more time to solve alignment; models get harder to monitor as they grow; internal monitoring is a first step.
zvi.zh: 放缓发展能为解决对齐争取更多时间；模型越大越难监控；内部监控是第一步。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI; the gap is smaller than thought; agent swarms may perform superhuman tasks first.
zvi.zh: 超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来；差距比想象的小；智能体集群可能最先完成超人任务。

feldman.en: Fast inference is the decisive metric: slow AI has no market, and wafer-scale chips beat GPUs by avoiding HBM weight movement.
feldman.zh: 快速推理是决定性指标:慢速 AI 没有市场,晶圆级芯片通过避开 HBM 权重搬运而胜过 GPU。

feldman.en: Demand, not chip supply, is the binding constraint; data centers, HBM, CoWoS and power lag, and buildout stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 约束来自需求而非芯片供给:数据中心、HBM、CoWoS 与电力都滞后,产能紧张将持续多年。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解:领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练,推理端也没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against incumbents, incremental gains fail; you need 100x better and full-stack control of chip, system, software and API.
feldman.zh: 对抗在位者,渐进改良无效;需要 100 倍提升,并全栈掌控芯片、系统、软件与 API。

feldman.en: Open-source models trail closed-source by only 3-5% yet cost far less, so open ecosystems drive adoption and pressure closed labs.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多,开放生态推动采用并倒逼闭源实验室。

johnbai.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
johnbai.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天式界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

johnbai.en: Designers should move up the stack toward taste and delight, letting AI handle production work and throwaway prototypes.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他主张设计师上移价值链，专注品味与愉悦感，把生产性工作和可丢弃的原型交给 AI。

johnbai.en: AI should get you off the computer, delegating email and calendar to bots that surface only action items.
johnbai.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 应让人离开电脑，把邮件、日历交给只呈现待办事项的智能体。

johnbai.en: Engineers built the first Grok Bot without designers and it succeeded; most design concepts should be discarded.
johnbai.zh: 他回顾 Grok Bot 初版由工程师而非设计师做出却成功了，并认为大多数设计概念本就该被丢弃。

johnbai.en: Specific-use-case bots built from simple blocks connected by AI, plus emotional prompting, outperform generic tools.
johnbai.zh: 到 2026 年，他相信由 AI 连接简单模块、面向具体场景的智能体，配合带情绪的提示，优于通用工具。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search, and multimodal data are needed for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，AGI 还需规划、搜索与多模态数据。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
demis.zh: 2025 年强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键。

demis.en: World models, continual learning, and memory are the missing pieces; AGI needs both scaling and innovation.
demis.zh: 2026 年指出世界模型、持续学习与记忆是缺失环节，AGI 需要 Scaling 与创新并重。

demis.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI must prove benefits like AlphaFold.
demis.zh: 2026 年将安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并强调 AI 须像 AlphaFold 一样证明实际益处。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年持续进步的主线：算力、数据、模型规模与算法架构改进相互放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction supplies unlimited data, with RLHF steering behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 取代 LSTM 靠的是并行化与注意力机制；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）负责引导行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, needing low-precision chips and minimal data movement.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他把瓶颈从训练转向推理：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，需要低精度专用芯片并尽量减少数据搬运。

jeffdean.en: Agents running for days on decomposed tasks, with context engineering and taste, will unlock harder problems than hour-scale chatbot use.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他从聊天机器人转向智能体式系统：智能体按分解任务连续运行数天，上下文工程与“品味”比写代码更稀缺。

jeffdean.en: Near-term worry is misinformation and misuse, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed, and small teams can still win.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年，他的风险判断更务实：近期担忧是虚假信息与滥用而非超级智能，监管或有必要，小团队仍可凭云端算力取胜。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting and treat language as a lasting interface, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词工程，并将语言视为持久的界面，而非聊天机器人的短暂阶段。

joellewenstein.en: AI products should balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品应平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有数年的设计工作来释放当前能力。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; let scaling laws lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；让缩放定律主导，用轻量产品释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes the source of truth; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；人类领导力仍需要用于艰难权衡。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world through predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的 AI 必须通过预测性世界模型处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: AGI needs embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data and lack generality.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而非仅靠软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

schmidhuber.en: Consciousness and self-awareness emerge from world models predicting the agent's own actions; AI has felt pain since 1990.
schmidhuber.zh: 意识与自我意识源于预测自身动作的世界模型；AI 自 1990 年起就已能感受疼痛。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧；AI 会设定自己的目标，安全担忧被夸大。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年算力会便宜得多，开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

schulman.en: LLMs combine pre-training with RLHF alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他强调大语言模型靠预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐，但幻觉难消，因为模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实准确。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, architectures and scalable oversight are the real path forward.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已认为单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力会遭遇收益递减，出路在新模态、新架构与可扩展监督，而非只靠规模。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; scalable oversight, models grading themselves, remains a key direction.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，可扩展监督、让模型自我评分始终是关键方向。
