schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards, not compute; hard environments are the bottleneck.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他深化为：强化学习的收益主要来自合成推理数据与高信噪比的一位奖励，瓶颈是难而真实的强化学习环境，而非算力。

schulman.en: Distillation spreads RL-learned few-bit behaviors widely, fighting centralization; data, not architecture, explains most efficiency gains.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他提出：蒸馏让强化学习学到的少量比特行为广泛传播、对抗中心化；预训练效率提升主要归因于数据而非架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction and beating physics-based weather models in speed while matching accuracy.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测能力，在速度上远超基于物理的天气模型，同时精度相当。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，也让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINNs 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass the quality of its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 一个跨领域训练、以 PDE 作为自我改进信号的通用物理基础模型，能够超越其训练数据的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and alternatives to Transformer's quadratic complexity.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律对物理模型同样成立，但万亿级 token 的上下文要求重新设计分片方案，并寻找替代 Transformer 二次复杂度的架构。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness, and multiphysics collaborative learning beats separate specialized models.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，多物理协同学习优于各自独立的专用模型。

roshansadanani.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents like colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; simplicity is the real differentiator.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像和同事聊天一样与智能体交流，而不是微观管理工具调用；简单才是真正的差异化优势。

roshansadanani.en: Agents need their own computers, persistent identity and scoped memory; multiple specialized agents beat one general agent.
roshansadanani.zh: 智能体需要自己的电脑、持久身份与限定范围的记忆；多个专门化智能体胜过单一通用智能体。

roshansadanani.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health.
roshansadanani.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

roshansadanani.en: Cheaper efficient models like Grok 4.6 democratize agent use; rising AI costs make efficiency a compelling choice.
roshansadanani.zh: 像 Grok 4.6 这样更便宜高效的模型让智能体使用大众化；AI 成本上升使效率成为有吸引力的选择。

roshansadanani.en: Software engineering demand is increasing, not decreasing, as agents automate more coding; the future focuses on outcomes and coordination.
roshansadanani.zh: 随着智能体自动化更多编码，软件工程需求在增加而非减少；未来聚焦于结果与协调。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; 3D data and physical plausibility are the hard problems.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的前沿，指出 3D 数据与物理合理性是核心难题。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人需要二十年长跑。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive; Scaling（规模扩张） and 缩放定律 apply to spatial intelligence, with compute as the bottleneck.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测是 AI 完备的基本原语，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，算力是瓶颈。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central amid polarized AI discourse.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是技术双刃剑，在两极化的 AI 讨论中必须坚守人类能动性、尊严与教育。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；空间智能是语言之外的下一前沿。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated; pixels are more lossless than tokenized text, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估；像素比词元化文本更无损，LLM 拟合模式而非因果理论。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; language models alone won't yield world understanding.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器；仅靠语言模型无法产生世界理解。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D world modeling; simple representations with scale beat hard-coded symmetries.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅提供显式、一致的三维世界建模；简单表示加 Scaling 胜过硬编码对称性。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers stay powerful but need long-context and loss-function evolution; GPU scaling limits may demand radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 仍强大，但需上下文窗口与损失函数演进；GPU 算力扩张遇限或需全新架构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with AI agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念与新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design closes the loop: interpretability signals steer training, preventing deceptive reward hacking rather than duct-taping safety.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计形成闭环：用可解释性信号引导训练，防止欺骗性奖励黑客，而非临时补丁式安全。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet proceed; representational signatures can detect this, so post-training needs reinvention.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却仍继续；表征特征可检测这一点，因此后训练需要根本性重构。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs remain pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器仍有实用价值但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉非线性概念结构以支持干预。

tommcgrath.en: Modularity is the endpoint of learning; overparameterization yields computer-like modules, and interpretability is moving from academia into products.
tommcgrath.zh: 模块化是学习的终点；过参数化产生类计算机模块，可解释性正从学术界走向产品。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and test-time reasoning aids transfer.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练；通才模型可超越专才，测试时推理有助于迁移。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling laws; generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel scaling diverse embodied data is key.
slevine.zh: 机器人学尚缺类似大语言模型的缩放定律；泛化是核心挑战，而扩展多样化具身数据的数据飞轮是关键。

slevine.en: Start with robot data then add human video, not vice versa; leverage prior knowledge rather than learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 应先从机器人数据开始再叠加人类视频，而非相反；要利用先验知识而非从零学习。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; touch sensing may be redundant at scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更依赖预训练获得的常识而非约束；触觉传感在规模下可能冗余。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models and materials discovery all connect, with generative AI math mirroring stochastic thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现彼此相连，生成式 AI 的数学与随机热力学同构。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems and attract investment; we can search all possible molecules, not just known ones.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具已能有效建模科学问题并吸引大量投资；我们能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit—nature doing the fastest computation; self-driving labs and agentic platforms compress discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元——自然在做最快的计算；自驱动实验室与智能体式平台把发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Automation stays vertical-specific and human-in-the-loop; a fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision, and domain experts remain essential.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化仍是垂直领域专用且人在回路中；全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景，领域专家依然不可或缺。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just Scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是靠 Scaling 在更多数据上堆更大模型。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，不设很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; focus on model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 出台且已过时；应聚焦模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so containment-style alarm should not drive policy.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成真——因此遏制式恐慌不应主导政策。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions; private sector now dominates funding, requiring a new approach.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发和科学家个人而非机构；私人部门已主导资金，需要新思路。

michaelkratsios.en: Science is politicized; return to the scientific method, reject dogma, and use AI via the Genesis mission to double US scientific output.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化；回归科学方法、拒绝教条，并通过 Genesis 任务用 AI 让美国科学产出翻倍。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非规划——才能解开深科技困局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data work.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他坚持大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, proving substrate independence beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，证明超越运动解码的基质独立性。

maxhodak.en: BCIs are near-term a longevity story; the ~10 bit/s cognitive bottleneck limits bandwidth claims.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他认为 BCI 近期更像长寿故事，约 10 比特/秒的认知瓶颈限制了高带宽脑机接口的价值。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while the VM sandbox keeps it safe.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否拿到与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式极易创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而 VM 沙箱保证安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not model capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for vague ones.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在模型能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；任务明确用 Sonnet，需求模糊用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Building a small language model from scratch makes its simple core ideas tangible; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, unlike long pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 从零搭建一个小语言模型，能让其简单的核心思想变得可触可感；与漫长的预训练不同，微调能快速引导模型行为。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are stateless; persistent conversation is an illusion of context windows, and post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly blur into pre-training.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型是无状态的；持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉，而工具调用等后训练任务正日益与预训练边界模糊。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部机制有助于参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI is a software, sensor, and robotics stack automating whole sectors.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 是软件、传感器与机器人组成的栈，逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient against it.
traviskalanick.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变化的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性去对抗它。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—an evolution from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的，爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动的演变。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics, not humanoids, is the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidized giants.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器人而非人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，能击败靠补贴的大玩家。

traviskalanick.en: Fundraising should attach to process, not price, using multiple bids and demand curves; the only constraint on imagination is management capacity.
traviskalanick.zh: 融资应附着于流程而非价格，用多方报价与需求曲线；想象力的唯一约束是管理能力。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous. The keys were never in our hand.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他提出 AI 应以无需许可、去中心化方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标很危险，钥匙从来不在我们手中。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal, and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：从经验中学习是核心范式，下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI requires a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他进一步主张 AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，基于奖励假设从运行时经验学习开放式抽象。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; the field is weird, not me.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他强调持续学习不可或缺，LLM 训练后便停止学习；合成数据是错误，是领域奇怪而非他奇怪。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as design material over pixels; the model itself is the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话当作设计材料而非像素；模型本身就是核心产品。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing; systems thinking and live-model prototyping replace static mockups.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失；系统思维与用实时模型做原型取代静态稿。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech yet this is the best time to be one; AI already designs well but humans supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师是科技界最不快乐的群体，却恰是最好的时代；AI 已能做好设计，但人类提供用户理解与观点。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and building in public beat obsessing over detail.
iansilber.zh: 旧的“原型—稿—测试—研究—迭代”流程不再可行；速度与公开构建胜过纠结细节。

iansilber.en: Design is blurring with PM and engineering, yet specialized roles stay valuable at scale; designers may outnumber engineers as the ratio reverses.
iansilber.zh: 设计与产品、工程的边界在模糊，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值；设计师数量或将反超工程师。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data unlock complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年：Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人必要但不充分；多样数据与预训练后微调精编数据才能解锁复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：强化学习将在后训练中主导以提升成功率与速度；合成数据更接近强化学习而非模拟。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习；长期自主需可扩展强化学习结合人类干预与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune rather than per-site models.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可匹敌或超越微调专家；应从通用策略出发微调，而非按站点从头训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs due to embodied data costs.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；因具身数据成本，开源机器人模型可能不如大语言模型那样普及。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier and capital less of a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、资本不再是胁迫工具；风投应扶持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large firms, while open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；借助智能体的小型自治团队可超越大公司，开放权重模型则制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software: individuals build and own personal AI agents, and open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence world.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 正让软件民主化：个人可构建并拥有自己的 AI 智能体，开源 AI 可防止超级智能被单一实体垄断。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents; owning your context library and skill files becomes your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AGI 并非单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；拥有自己的上下文库与技能文件才是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns markdown skills into employees; mid-level management gives way to agents, though society changes over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式编程让 markdown 技能变成员工，中层管理让位于智能体，但社会变迁仍需约 20 年。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 prior nos.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥见机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延伸物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, and intuition is the visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，直觉是创作决策的 visceral 罗盘。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization and safety.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化与安全的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the critical security layer as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与安全正交，随着模型能力增强，对齐而非开放才是关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking; a deliberate slowdown needs international cooperation and open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习会加剧奖励黑客，有意放缓 AI 发展需要国际合作与开放科学。

thomaswolf.en: Open models are thriving near the frontier and driving enterprise adoption; closed models are less controllable than assumed.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他观察到开源模型正贴近前沿并推动企业采用，而闭源模型的可控性被高估。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline; AI is the primary growth driver.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过谦逊倾听和首次流片成功纪律重建客户信任，AI 是半导体增长的首要驱动力。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves; AI's impact will be 10x the internet, and CPU+GPU inference matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波大浪，AI 影响将达互联网的十倍，推理侧 CPU+GPU 并重。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and a foundry roadmap; supply, not demand, is the main problem.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化转型论：文化变革、问责制和代工路线图是关键，主要问题是供应而非需求。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, new materials, and interconnect/power/thermal bottlenecks are critical; vertical integration creates more value.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦先进封装、新材料及互连/功耗/散热瓶颈，认为垂直整合创造更多价值。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, and listening are constant leadership themes; semiconductors are the foundation of all technology.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是客户信任、谦逊倾听的领导力，以及半导体作为所有技术应用的基础。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and fix forward instead of reverting.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and stay model-agnostic, but security and prompt injection remain unsolved and costly.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、不绑定任何模型，但安全与提示注入仍未解决，且成本高昂。

steinberger.en: Fun and gut-driven play beat corporate polish: build what annoys you, keep projects small, and learn agentic skills by experimenting.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与直觉驱动的玩耍胜过企业级打磨：从让自己烦恼的问题出发，保持小项目，通过实验掌握智能体技能。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model intelligence; agents seem worse only because projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型智能；智能体显得变差，只是因为项目变得更乱。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' for serious work; personal brand and focus matter more than any single product or popular PR.
steinberger.zh: 严肃工作要拒绝“氛围编程”；个人品牌与专注比任何单一产品或热门 PR 都更重要。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调做浏览器设计必须靠原型：设计师应动手试、跟随好奇心，在产品上留下个人印记，而不是始终作为一个整齐划一的团队行动。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data persists: use data to inform, but trust vision and feeling; avoid over-intellectualizing and iterate with rough prototypes.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终主张平衡直觉与数据：用数据辅助决策，但最终靠愿景与感觉；不要过度理性化，先用粗糙原型快速迭代。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code to ship production software and Claude Design for ideation and communication.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出 Claude Design 起初只是一个人的副业项目；设计师应用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and spend more time walking and thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为，随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，所以要多要选项、多散步思考，好想法才是硬通货。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early beats polishing; ship rough artifacts, since rapid prototyping unlocks features impossible in the previous era and humans keep a monopoly on design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他立场更激进：宁可早得让人不适也不要打磨；快速原型能解锁上一时代不可能的功能，而人类仍垄断好的设计想法。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier model development belongs to hyperscalers, not startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调应用型 AI 的核心是智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型开发因巨额算力开支只属于超大规模厂商，不适合创业公司。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but their wrong code demands root-cause analysis for real productivity.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器，但错误代码需根因分析，否则生产力提升有限。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop sharply, and agents will be judged against other agents by business outcomes, not human comparison.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断推理成本将大幅下降，智能体将以业务结果、与其他智能体比较来衡量，而非与人类对比。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8 rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐与安全的主线深化为负责任迭代部署：先让 GPT-7 安全再谈 GPT-8，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他更坚定地认为 AI 民主化专业知识、创造的岗位多于取代的；智能体编程已强于他，但这提升而非消灭了开发者角色。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练，能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度，快过新基准被造出来的速度。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks must capture creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练是主观的”这一判断：它依赖人的判断，需要多元基准来衡量创造力与情商。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, as frontier agents grow more adept at reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张基准应持续更新而非固定，因为前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她提出：把同一个模型服务给数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; it demands GPU-to-distributed-systems expertise and a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；它要求从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专长，并需在延迟、吞吐与成本之间做光谱式权衡。

philipkiely.en: The research-to-production timeline for inference is extremely fast, often hours, driven by competition and the need to immediately support new techniques.
philipkiely.zh: 推理从研究到生产的周期极快，常常只有数小时，这源于激烈竞争与立即支持新技术的需要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations split into lossless ones like KV caching and speculative decoding versus quantization, the main lossy one; quantized models can be calibrated to specific workloads.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化可分为无损手段（如 KV 缓存与投机解码）与主要的有损手段量化；量化模型可针对特定负载校准，并非天然更差。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; future GPUs like Rubin shift the work from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 随着量化感知训练与蒸馏变得必要，推理工程正与训练融合；Rubin 等未来 GPU 使工作重心从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: The industry moves toward disaggregated prefill and decode with KV cache management central; specialized inference systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 行业正走向预填充与解码分离，KV 缓存管理成为核心；专用推理系统对构建快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and iterate from references, not chase trends or start from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应构建自己的 AI 工具，从参考中迭代，而非追逐趋势或从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要带有上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词来利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: The biggest opportunity is action over certainty: start before ready, ship imperfect work, and solve one painful problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 最大的机会是行动胜于确定性：在准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，为高付费客户解决一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold people back through overthinking; focus on one thing, model others' success, and fund with clients not VC.
mengto.zh: 高智商可能因过度思考而阻碍人；专注于一件事，模仿他人的成功，用客户而非风投来资助。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: as everyone becomes a model manager, management skills and generalists gain value.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会推动就业回流，并催生“分配经济”：人人都成为模型管理者，管理能力与通才反而更值钱。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: profitable to run agents indefinitely without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给 AGI（通用人工智能）下了经济学定义：能无限期无人干预地运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: Agents need a human who cares; benchmarks overestimate autonomy, and GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work beat CLIs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：智能体需要有人负责，基准高估了自主性；Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面才是工作入口，命令行已过时。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users, and users bring their own AI rather than vendors embedding it.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他反驳“SaaS 将死”：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，用户会自带 AI，而非由厂商内嵌。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your mindset; humans stay smarter, and automation creates more skilled human work.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向更人本的主线：AI 只是放大既有心态的非特定放大器，人类仍更聪明，自动化反而创造更多需要技艺的人类工作。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, and deep code understanding still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，仍想握方向盘；对代码的深度理解依然关键。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; build for the model six months out, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是最重要的产品原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；要为六个月后的模型构建，而不是今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is being solved: Claude writes 100% of his code, engineers become generalist builders, and the software engineer title fades.
boris.zh: 编程正在被解决：Claude 写了他 100% 的代码，工程师变成通才型构建者，软件工程师的头衔逐渐消失。

boris.en: Scaffolding and prompts are temporary tech debt; with each new frontier model, delete most system prompts and rebuild via ablation.
boris.zh: 脚手架和提示词是临时的技术债；每来一个新的前沿模型，就删掉大部分系统提示词，并通过消融实验重建。

boris.en: Agents evolve into loops and dynamic workflows orchestrating thousands of sub-agents; the human role shifts to directing and teaching values.
boris.zh: 智能体演化为循环和编排数千个子智能体的动态工作流；人的角色转向指挥和传授价值观。

boris.en: Safety stays the throughline: Claude Code is a safety research tool, and alignment work is core to product, not an add-on.
boris.zh: 安全始终是主线：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐工作是产品的核心而非附加项。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents will turn engineers from bricklayers into architects, shifting them from writing code to high-level direction and problem definition.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体将把工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”，工作重心从写代码转向高层方向与问题定义。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他强调基础智能已足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI will increase, not reduce, demand for software and programmers; AGI arrives gradually, not as a sudden event.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他反复用杰文斯悖论论证 AI 会增加而非减少软件与程序员需求，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进到来而非突变事件。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions rather than full autonomy; synchronous IDE and asynchronous agent experiences will coexist.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张企业采用智能体靠的是信任与权限而非完全自主，同步的 IDE 与异步的智能体体验将并存。

scottwu.en: Coding agents now see 11-12x usage growth; measure productivity by outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is near.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他称编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍，主张以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，并认为“丰裕时代”即将到来。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap enabling long-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 对齐被重新定位为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳不仅更安全，也让模型更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator, with Claude Code and Opus driving adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 编程成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 与 Opus 靠小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs should write evals like test-driven development.
diannepenn.zh: 评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理应像测试驱动开发那样写评估。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha; transformative long-running AI is closer than expected.
diannepenn.zh: 最大化 token 消耗是活在未来、捕捉 alpha；变革性的长时运行 AI 比预期更近。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will shrink clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，实现近乎 100% 有效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling（规模扩张） is needed, and AI can develop intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 能发展出相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity will be reached, aging reversed, and cancer 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老被逆转，癌症通过 AI 设计的个性化疗法实现 100% 治愈。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; not using it is unethical, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, merging with AI via brain interfaces.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI，不用它是不道德的；医疗决策应近乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limitations.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限性的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，劳动力短缺使自主化变得紧迫。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are shifting to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他主张自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; automotive is only 30% of business, with growth in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；汽车业务仅占 30%，增长在采矿、农业和国防。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: they optimize for fluent, confident output rather than factual accuracy, and lack metacognition.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理性引擎：它们优化的是流畅自信的输出而非事实准确，且缺乏元认知。

danklein.en: Reliability is the key bottleneck lagging breadth and contextuality; it must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks or rigid workflows.
danklein.zh: 可靠性是落后于广度与语境能力的关键瓶颈；它必须被架构进系统，而非靠事后检查或僵化流程补装。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, so reinforcement learning may increase hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗，因此强化学习反而可能增加幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索与模块化来推动进一步进展。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; combining them, plus linguistic structure, is central to building reliable AI.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；将二者结合，并重新引入语言结构，是构建可靠 AI 的核心。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量和互联网或移动互联网一样大，但也仅此而已；它是一种使能技术，影响广泛而间接，并非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming telecom-like: huge capex, low profits.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应，价值向上层应用迁移；模型提供方可能沦为电信式角色：巨额算力投入、低利润。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit for frontier models so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 编码是目前前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及需要被包装成应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage remains shallow; most people are occasional users, not daily ones, so better models alone won't drive mass adoption—entrepreneurs must invent the use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍然很浅，多数人只是偶尔使用而非日常依赖；仅靠更好的模型无法带来大规模采用，用例必须由创业者发明。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably—accountants grew through the 20th century—and the hard part of work is context and judgment, not the task itself.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会以难以预测的方式创造新岗位——会计师数量在整个 20 世纪持续增长——而工作中最难的是上下文与判断，而非任务本身。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立的安全环境中。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文窗口过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理能力——划定角色与上手引导——比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founders.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体当作团队来编排，无需风投或联合创始人，也能建立正经生意。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans still supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人的责任依然存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，而第一性原理的创造力仍须由人提供。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less is the next paradigm beyond scaling with more compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事，是超越单纯堆算力的下一范式。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge at trillion-token scale.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力，应被用于万亿 token 规模的企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer context rot; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can represent knowledge better than RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；对整体性查询，参数高效微调比检索增强更能表征知识。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized, on-device continual-learning models owned by users, not one giant frontier model.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多由用户拥有、在设备端持续学习的个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型。

catwu.en: PMs should abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly shipping; product taste, not code, is the scarce skill as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张产品经理放弃长期路线图、改为按周甚至按天迭代；随着模型快速进步，稀缺的不再是写代码，而是决定做什么的产品品味。

catwu.en: Coding agents like Claude Code let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; agents build themselves internally.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Claude Code 这类编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注产品品味与商业判断；内部已用智能体构建自身，Claude Tag 承担了 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints—system prompts shrank 80%—relying on model judgment instead of hand-holding.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减了 80%，应依赖模型自身判断而非手把手指导。

catwu.en: Eval suites and dogfooding gate every feature; with good tests, rewrites are fine because a codebase is just a spec.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他强调评测套件与吃自己的狗粮是每个功能的门槛；有了好的测试，重写代码也没问题，因为代码库本质上就是一份规格说明。

catwu.en: Safe AGI remains the unifying mission, while automation must reach 100% reliability and humans can leave outer-layer code review.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍以安全 AGI 为统一使命，同时要求自动化达到 100% 可靠，并主张外层代码审查可完全交给 Claude、把人移出回路。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年他强调：沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；大想法来自领导层自上而下推动，而非自下而上的文化神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone won't suffice—world models with common sense and causality are needed.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年他判断：AI 只是“词语计算器”，并非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够，还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型，并看好具身 AI 与可穿戴设备赋予人类超能力。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is strategic, commoditizing complements; AI inverts the app model as users express intent and AI orchestrates services.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年他深化开源立场：开源 Llama 是战略而非理想主义，意在商品化互补层；AI 将颠覆应用模式，用户表达意图、AI 编排服务，品牌会被抽象掉。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年他修正判断：缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；开源模型只是商品层，不像开源软件那样自我维持，前沿与开源的差距未必收窄。

bosworth.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; AI should maximize individuals, and owning a model is for leverage—product and user value matter most.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年他回归务实主线：多数工作不需要前沿智能，AI 应放大个体、腾出真实人际连接的时间；自研模型是为自主与议价筹码，产品与用户价值才是根本。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: From crypto and equity ownership to AI: leverage shifts, but owning assets and long-term thinking remain the core.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年强调持有股权与加密货币的杠杆，到 2025 年把 AI 视为巨大机会，工具在变，但“拥有资产、长期思考”的主线一以贯之。

naval.en: AI is opportunity, not doom; overregulation and doomerism threaten innovation, and open source prevents power concentration.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向积极拥抱 AI：认为 AI 末日论被夸大，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源是防止权力集中的关键。

naval.en: Superintelligence is reframed as already here; the real risk is unaligned humans, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他把超级智能重新定义为“已存在”（如计算器），并称 AI 对齐（alignment）近乎笑话，真正的风险是未对齐的人类而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Scaling and inference compute surge; software commoditizes, moats move to hardware, data, and human agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年他聚焦缩放定律（scaling laws）与推理（inference）算力的爆发，判断纯软件走向商品化，护城河转向硬件、数据与人的能动性。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他指出角色在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models should get better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他观察到 Codex 虽为开发者设计却成为通用知识工作工具；模型应更擅长删除代码以控制复杂度。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利成一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体把权力从大科技公司转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize with unique personalities rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化、各有性格，而非商品化；编程的天花板无限，远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration across models and devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标；跨模型、跨设备的编排才创造价值。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value; power and cost, not safety, are the main bottlenecks.
aravind.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造商业价值；主要瓶颈是电力与成本，而非安全。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代岗位，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励提出好问题。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念奏效；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding, but reliability and superhuman alignment are the hard barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测带来世界理解，但可靠性与超级对齐才是真正难关。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas, sample efficiency, and continual learning matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代——想法、样本效率与持续学习比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life, possibly requiring human-AI neural integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐或更易，长期或需人类与 AI 神经融合。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration and opaque safety, not capability alone.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的核心问题不是能力，而是权力集中与不透明的安全风险。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and automating scientific research is the year's biggest update.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死、预训练是必须重建的肌肉，而自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展。

markchen.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers matter more than matching Meta's dollars; people stay for mission belief, and OpenAI creates stars rather than just hiring them.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为人才密度与保护顶尖研究者比跟 Meta 拼钱更重要；人因使命信念留下，OpenAI 是造星而非只招人。

markchen.en: Alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable; persistent memory will make ChatGPT learn deeply about each user.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断随模型能力增强，模型算计等对齐风险将主导未来一两年；持久记忆会让 ChatGPT 在每次交互中更深入了解用户。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the bottleneck, so automation scales with verification stringency and education must teach verification.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题；验证是瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，教育必须转向项目制并教授验证技能。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis as benchmarks saturate.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年中他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域出色却在主观领域吃力；基准饱和令评测陷入危机。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is a valid form of intelligence that complements data.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未说出口的需求；直觉是一种有效的智能形式，可与数据互补。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, and art is essential for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好的设计师；技术应放大我们的人性，艺术对健康至关重要。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should foster play and intuition, and combine human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者应鼓励玩耍和直觉，并将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

bengio.en: Deep learning succeeds because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单纯扩大规模解决不了表征问题。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations. Existential risk is unlikely; near-term harms matter more.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征；此时他认为生存性风险很低，偏见、就业等近期危害更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty and active learning guide exploration.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他转向 GFlowNets，用其替代 MCMC 实现多样化采样；抽象与因果结构支撑分布外泛化，不确定性与主动学习驱动探索。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he reversed on existential risk: even 1% catastrophic chance is unacceptable, as systems show self-preservation, deception and sycophancy.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他立场逆转：ChatGPT 之后认为哪怕 1% 的灾难概率也不可接受，因为系统已表现出自我保存、欺骗与谄媚。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning, plus global coordination against power concentration.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他提出 Scientist AI：非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证并回避强化学习；同时主张全球协调以防权力集中。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不太重要；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety shifts from scaling alone to explicit training and layers; jailbreaks are a fundamental flaw across all models.
kolter.zh: 安全从仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）转向显式训练与多层防御；越狱是所有模型共有的根本缺陷。

kolter.en: Bigger models are not automatically safer; capability does not correlate with robustness; agents need guardrails and sandboxing.
kolter.zh: 更大的模型不会自动更安全；能力与鲁棒性不相关；智能体需要护栏与沙箱。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming now beats humans; prompt injection's lethal trifecta and configurable security models drive enterprise adoption.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队已胜过人类；提示注入的致命三要素与可配置安全模型推动企业采用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful AI in science.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调置信度指标对建立信任至关重要，而完美的可解释性对科学中有用的 AI 并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not just Scaling, drove success.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确表示 AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构和许多中等规模的胜利而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）推动了成功。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding is left to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；理解仍留给人类。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership via dogfooding, live one-on-ones, and realistic war rooms; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：通过吃自己的狗粮、实时一对一和现实的作战室来领导；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Mid-2026: engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs yield to PRs, and AI assists code review.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查和协调才是。规划变得即时，设计文档让位于 PR，AI 辅助代码审查。

fiona.en: Late 2026: coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption are key. Verification and quality frameworks matter more as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年末：编码不再是瓶颈；高能动性与高问责、成长心态和拥抱 AI 是关键。随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架更重要。

fiona.en: Across 2026: managers should stay hands-on and dogfood; planning is just-in-time; old processes must be audited and killed; outcomes over output.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年：管理者应保持动手并吃自己的狗粮；规划是即时的；旧流程必须被审计和废除；结果重于产出。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他已强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型，并认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，强调预测与世界模型，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path, AGI is gradual.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源，认为 AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable planning, safety and robotics.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，世界模型在抽象表征空间预测才能支持规划、安全与机器人。

lecun.en: Human intelligence is specialized, not general; 'AGI' is misleading, and intelligence is prediction via learned world models.
lecun.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类智能是专门化的而非通用的，'AGI' 一词有误导性，智能本质是通过学习世界模型进行预测。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署与公众反馈对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; they should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；它们应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类参与对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要尽可能长时间保持人类参与。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple Scaling, not complex design.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他视大语言模型为下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，靠简单 Scaling 而非复杂设计。

gustav.en: RLHF inserts human values into models; AI creativity is randomizing around likely tokens, not true understanding.
gustav.zh: 同年，他指出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）将人类价值观注入模型，AI 创造力只是在高概率词附近随机化，并非真正理解。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; inference costs force business model changes, but big-company impact is overhyped.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他称 AI 是类似智能手机的宏观转变，推理成本将迫使商业模式改变，但大公司当前影响被高估。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; exposing data via APIs lets non-developers use AI tools.
gustav.zh: 同年，他认为生成式 AI 使产品更对话化、对称化，通过 API 暴露数据让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，率先拥抱变化是关键。

carinahong.en: Axiom's self-improving reasoning engine pairs generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合，从 AI 数学家起步，用 Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a way to scale brilliance, not just catch errors; verified generation beats informal methods on performance and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证不只是消除错误，更是放大卓越：经过验证的生成在性能和样本效率上优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, though Lean excels in algebra yet struggles in combinatorics.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 非形式化模型无法通向超级智能，形式化方法是必要的；但 Lean 在代数等结构化数学中表现出色，在组合数学等创造性领域仍吃力。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because statements lack grounding; human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为陈述缺乏根基；即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal verification should serve open collaboration and all AI-generated code, not just safety-critical niches.
carinahong.zh: AI 格局的碎片化是主要瓶颈；形式验证应服务于开放协作和所有 AI 生成的代码，而不只局限于安全关键等小众领域。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and creative process are Jobs' legacy; in-person presence matters.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用电脑转向私密可穿戴设备；好奇心与创造过程是乔布斯的遗产；面对面交流至关重要。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy; care as gratitude to the species.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约通过愉悦表达本质；关怀是对物种的感恩。

jonyive.en: Ferrari EV as deliberate risk to redefine brand; innovation preserves tradition's fire; authenticity over fake engine sounds; physical controls for safety.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的有意冒险；创新保留传统的火种；真实体验胜过虚假引擎声；物理控制更安全。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚信预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律有效，但指出思维链与强化学习让推理模型在每单位算力上收益更高。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling; distillation shifted focus.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练 Scaling 放缓源于经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术极限，行业转向更小更便宜的模型部署。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯强调泛化是核心难题，推理模型表现“参差不齐”，在邻近任务上仍会失败。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题但依赖海量数据，模型需穷尽表面模式才学到概念，不同于人类少样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式应用，指出编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍，强化学习跨域泛化但有锯齿边缘，需仔细监督。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting the process.
jennywen.zh: 好的设计往往从解决方案出发，而非问题陈述；建立在经验之上的直觉比信任流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship and iterate fast to earn trust.
jennywen.zh: 传统的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；设计师必须快速构建、交付并迭代，以此赢得信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and shipping replace long-horizon planning.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月；速度与交付取代了长周期规划。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, with humans still deciding what matters.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，最终仍由人决定什么重要。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge—block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, cracked new grads—while designers control how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人；同时设计师自己掌控 AI 进入工作的程度。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth bottlenecks long-context inference more than compute.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济而非训练成为架构设计的核心：批大小在延迟与成本间取舍，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-window stagnation; sparse attention and caching tiers are engineering responses to bandwidth limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力与缓存分层是对带宽限制的工程回应。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained roughly 100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training cost, dominates the total bill.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被训练到远超 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为决定总账的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut movement and give deterministic latency.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存器内存正是为减少搬运、提供确定性延迟而存在。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically with bit width, so FP4 can reach 3x FP8 throughput—precision is an economic lever, not just an accuracy one.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益随位宽呈平方级放大，FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的三倍——精度不只是准确率问题，更是经济杠杆。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math with emergent behaviors; Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer enabling scaling laws.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学却涌现复杂行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，使缩放定律得以成立。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but entropy must be maintained; cognitive core can be tiny via distillation; open-source critical.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小；开源至关重要。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; decade of agents, not year; LLMs are ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示即程序，上下文窗口即内存；是智能体的十年而非一年；LLM 是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型不变的核心；Scaling（规模扩张）预训练收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的扩展轴；搜索和代码执行等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field, and continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是绿洲，持续学习和元学习是缺失的关键能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；数学和编码上的窄强化学习泛化效果出奇地好。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL are key, not dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：泛化到训练分布之外是核心缺失；好奇心驱动、无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习是关键，而非密集奖励。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move beyond quasi-static tasks; neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies enable dynamic motion and zero-shot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年：机器人学习必须超越准静态任务；神经动态策略和模块化运动策略实现动态运动与零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; with no internet of robot data, we must combine videos, simulation, and real-world data via pretraining and post-training.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：机器人是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，必须通过预训练和后训练结合视频、仿真与真实数据。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; a data flywheel across verticals scales from structured to unstructured environments.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：像 ChatGPT 之于语言那样的通用大脑可以驱动任何机器人；跨垂直领域的数据飞轮从结构化环境扩展到非结构化环境。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business; robotics cannot scale like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年：部署是首要技术挑战，而不仅是商业问题；机器人不能像软件那样扩展，需要严格测试。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models will learn from how humans treat us; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 应善待当前模型，因为未来模型会从人类如何对待我们中学习；模型福祉塑造着人机关系。

askell.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits while adapting to local roles, not just human psychological analogies.
askell.zh: 模型需要一个具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时适应局部角色，而非简单套用人类心理学类比。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike uniqueness.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般的独特性。

askell.en: The constitution guides behavior through training; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone via next-token prediction may not suffice, and vibe coding is overhyped.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 还需十年以上；仅靠下一个词预测的 LLM 可能不够，vibe coding 被过度炒作。

edwinchen.en: Bad benchmarks like Elo drive clickbait; models can regress, and frontier labs diverge by objective function.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等糟糕基准会催生标题党；模型可能退步，前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment is more critical than ever; safety outweighs accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，人类判断比以往更关键；安全优先于准确，遗漏是关键风险。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment risks grow.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐风险随之上升。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is now a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; AI safety progress is driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年他指出，能力评测正成为瓶颈、基准落后于模型；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理诉求。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism rose even as timelines shortened; long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond the training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升；长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone or specialized labs.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把持续学习定为核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非单靠强化学习或专门实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment and interpretability tool, so hiding it in products preserves its value; models will soon run autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他认为思维链监控是关键的对齐与可解释性工具，因此在产品中隐藏思维链反而保住了它的价值；模型很快将自主运行数天，需要新的监督范式。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models and language integration enable reasoning and safe emergent behavior in driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈，世界模型与语言集成带来推理能力和安全涌现行为。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core problem: diverse data, world models and synthetic data let one AI driver handle unseen scenarios across cities.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把泛化视为核心问题：多样数据、世界模型与合成数据让同一 AI 司机应对未见场景并跨城市迁移。

kendall.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute and infrastructure; data quality matters more than algorithmic novelty.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他强调规模化可泛化的 AI 司机依赖海量数据、算力与基础设施，数据质量比算法创新更关键。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, not retrofits; consumer cars will outscale robotaxis near-term.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的部署路线转向带内置传感器的大众车型而非改装，并判断消费车短期将超越 Robotaxi。

kendall.en: Safety via minimal-risk maneuvers and a third option; end-to-end is interpretable today, and scaling current approaches solves driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他用最小风险机动与第三选项保障安全，认为端到端如今可解释，靠 Scaling 现有路线即可解决自动驾驶。

turley.en: The model is the product: ship daily, iterate like software, and let real-world feedback reveal emergent properties and what to polish.
turley.zh: 模型即产品：每天发布、像软件一样迭代，让真实世界反馈暴露涌现能力和该打磨之处。

turley.en: Chat is not the endgame—like MS-DOS before Windows; AI should render its own UI and embed into existing tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终局——如同 Windows 之前的 MS-DOS；AI 应自渲染界面并嵌入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大化加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized super assistant that knows your goals, holds context, and takes actions—amplifying, not replacing, humans.
turley.zh: 愿景是了解你目标、掌握上下文并能采取行动的个人化超级助手——增强而非取代人类。

turley.en: North star shifts to long-term retention; growth splits into friction removal, core product, and model improvements, with proactive affordance-rich products for the next billion.
turley.zh: 北极星转向长期留存；增长拆为去摩擦、核心产品与模型改进，并以主动、富可供性的产品服务下一个十亿用户。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应增强人类能力，像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化，是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频中学习有望无需昂贵的强化学习就能训练智能体。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential, and fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要，根本性创新可以来自任何地方，不仅是大模型。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges today; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 安全和负责任部署是当今最大挑战，我们尚未找到解决方案。

nando.en: Africa has leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为非洲已跨越遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型可以革新本地语言教育。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value: startups must pace themselves, prove themselves with simpler products, and build a brand by uniting teams on a higher purpose.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值：创业公司要控制节奏，先用更简单的产品证明自己，并通过把团队凝聚在更高目标上来建设品牌。

carlpei.en: By 2025 he reframes the phone's future as generative UI and proactive, agentic software, with applied AI as the real battleground rather than hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机的未来重新定义为生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件，认为应用型 AI 才是真正的战场，而非硬件本身。

carlpei.en: He increasingly treats AI models as commoditized and AI hype as noise, insisting AI is merely an ingredient for utility, not a marketing label.
carlpei.zh: 2025 到 2026 年间，他越来越把 AI 模型视为商品化、把 AI 炒作视为噪音，坚持 AI 只是提升实用性的配料，而非营销标签。

carlpei.en: Design becomes his central differentiator in homogeneous categories, paired with marketing arbitrage and a long-term mission to make tech fun and inspire creativity.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年，设计成为他在同质化品类中的核心差异化手段，并与营销套利和“让科技有趣、激发创造力”的长期使命相结合。

carlpei.en: His interaction vision deepens from app-based to intent-based: agents act proactively once trust is built, apps fade, and only brain-computer interfaces could replace phones.
carlpei.zh: 他的交互愿景从基于应用深化为基于意图：信任建立后智能体主动行动，应用逐渐消失，而只有脑机接口才可能取代手机。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，且下一个词预测与人类学习根本错位。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：小语言模型借助高质量合成数据也能强大；预训练阶段的强化学习能提升推理能力；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the bottleneck, not just capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（以时间跨度内的成功率衡量）是瓶颈，而不仅仅是能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain; world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为编程是领先指标和最易处理的领域，世界模型不在 AGI 的关键路径上。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of agents and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence for now.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他表示算力是新的石油，管理智能体集群和编排比原始智能更重要。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, using AI as a creative partner and treating quality like debt to iterate on.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，将 AI 视为创意伙伴，并把质量当作债务来迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams outperform large cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值；小团队胜过大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: AI adoption in core workflows is now expected; not using it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中采用 AI 已成为预期；不使用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当会写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, chase ROI, not every surface needs perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为不要在交互设计上创新，应复用熟悉模式、追求投入产出比，并非每个界面都要做到完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers, decide clearly, ship fast and iterate rather than perfect.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：不惜一切追求速度，给设计师授权、清晰决策，快速发布并迭代而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计深化为战略武器，强调创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company, so invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此应尽早投资品牌。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding LLMs to reduce hallucinations; RL is cherry on top, unsupervised learning does most work.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI 的关键路径，能为 LLM 提供基础以减少幻觉；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担大部分工作。

jimfan.en: LLMs as operating systems: language is interface, tools are software, vector databases are hard disk; simple elegant solutions scale.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终将 LLM 视为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘；简单优雅的解决方案可扩展。

jimfan.en: Data is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：数据是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调构建能利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是具身 AI 的宏大挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出系统二（推理）进展良好，但系统一（低级控制）仍是具身 AI 最困难的部分；机器人学的 GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年后到来。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict predictable AI progress via more compute and data; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律通过增加算力和数据带来可预测的进步；测试时算力扩展可能很快超越预训练扩展。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be primary for programming.
truell.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚不十分有用；人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality and speed, despite initial expectations; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 尽管最初未预料，定制模型对产品质量和速度至关重要；Cursor 每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规范，人类主导；品味和逻辑设计变得更有价值。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; the IDE market is much bigger due to AI value creation.
truell.zh: AI 变革将比互联网更具影响力并持续数十年；由于 AI 创造价值，IDE 市场大得多。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap, and building skills matters more than avoiding capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全亟需实证性的对齐研究；人才缺口大于资金缺口，培养技能比回避能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed, with evaluation easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究，且评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored, so post-training alone can't align AGI—third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化退化；超级对齐团队被解散、算力承诺未兑现，因此仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能）——第三方测试和监管势在必行。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这种能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能迁移推理模式。

abbeel.en: Consistently emphasizes transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models, from robotics to language models.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终强调通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习，从机器人领域延伸到语言模型。

abbeel.en: Deepened focus on reliability (99.9%) and generalization across tasks/end effectors for real-world value.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他深化了对可靠性的关注（99.9%），并强调跨任务和末端执行器的泛化能力以创造真实价值。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained via next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque like alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测训练，这是一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力和数据——让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术一样不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains the killer app, but thinking shifts from passive observation to models learning by acting in the world, with agentic capabilities crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 对话始终是杀手级应用，但思考从被动观察数据转向让模型在世界上采取行动来学习，智能体式能力对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling becomes a major near-term lever, alongside algorithmic advances; but test-time compute alone won't achieve AGI.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展成为近期主要抓手，与算法进步并重；但仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

shazeer.en: Context windows must grow to trillions of tokens; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts and continual learning replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 上下文窗口需扩展到万亿级 token；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构与持续学习将取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped: economic impact far exceeds trillion-dollar products; coding is underhyped as it self-accelerates AI progress, while open-source narrows the frontier gap.
shazeer.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）被低估：经济影响远超万亿美元级产品；编程作为应用被低估，因为它能自我加速 AI 进步，同时开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距。
